correctness.rationale: Proved over arbitrary fields: rank-two implies automorphism; rank-one maps must kill one natural generator because the algebra equals its square; preservation then reduces to one quadratic. Every singular map is square-zero or idempotent. Counted roots by incidences over all finite fields, including even characteristic, and independently counted monomial automorphisms by support. The verifier exhaustively checked the fields of orders two, three, four, five, and seven from defining polynomial equations.

value.rationale: A complete classification of the nonunit stratum of the endomorphism monoid for all perfect two-dimensional evolution algebras identifies the precise triangular support boundary and a quadratic discriminant control of retractions. The global equality of idempotent rank-one and nonzero square-zero endomorphisms and the total exact census for all finite fields are natural structural and arithmetic invariants, not merely small sample enumeration.
